**Key findings:** True walking-distance options are very thin — this is a forest hotel outside a 1,500-person village. Only two properties let you walk home after dinner: the Waldhotel Sonnora itself (from €268/night, 15 rooms, zero logistics) and Ferienwohnung Bretz in Dreis village (~600 m downhill, €115–178/night self-catering apartment). Salmhotel in Salmtal is the cheapest nearby option (doubles €90/night incl. breakfast) but it's 3 km on unlit country roads — taxi recommended after a wine pairing. For Wittlich-based stays (6–7 km), La Roseraie (4.8 ★, boutique manor, ~$130) and Hotel Vulcano Lindenhof (pool/spa, from ~€131) are the top picks.
